subject: Important Update: Changes to Company Policy
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to inform you about the recent changes to our company policy regarding remote work. Starting next month, all employees will be required to work in the office at least three days a week. This decision was made to enhance collaboration and team productivity. Please review the updated policy document attached for more details. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
